svg.text: PairsWarp<diagonal, 4>: 9,424 bytes of shared memory per warp (block)
union: the boxes and float corners, then the polygons
W: written, R: read (filled when written). drop_empty only runs when the queue holds more than 32 items; it rewrites
todo in place. The boxes and float corners are dead by step 5, so the polygons reuse their memory: that takes the block from
12,240 to 9,424 bytes. With 126 registers per lane, an A100 SM then runs 16 of these one-warp blocks at once.
